name: fix93_kill_xp
verifies: fix-93 [owner]: the hero gets the full kill XP when his own hit hurt the victim and any other NPC finishes it ('we practically killed it'); no XP for a stranger's kill of a victim he never hurt; paid once.
steps: spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=3 side=front as=w1
spawn Wolf attitude=neutral dist=4 side=left as=w2
spawn Orc_Warrior_01 attitude=neutral dist=3 side=right as=orc
log -- a wolf the hero never hurt, killed by the orc: no XP
log -- the hero hurts the other wolf, the orc kills it: full kill XP
notes: strike = one melee hit resolved now (ScenarioRunner.Fix93, BuildHit -> CombatService.Strike); ActorVitals marks a victim the hero's hit took HP from (HurtByPlayer, saved) and ActorDefeated carries it when the defeat has a killer; KillXpAwarder pays once per NPC (G3 DefeatedByPlayer). The XP message (GO_XP) shows as for the hero's own kill. xpgain = XP since xpmark (fix-97, r39 'xp=0: was 2500': a fresh hero has the CP start XP, Ardea_Spawn_Point GiveXP 500 x 5).
